data.statement: At their mature 28-day-plus checkpoint, the three truthful v4 Pins total 218 public impressions. The goat accounts for 131 impressions, both Pin clicks, and the only save; alligator has 72 impressions and ceramic eye 15. None produced an outbound click, attributable Pinterest site session, or affiliate click.
data.decision: Archive the mature candidate measurements while leaving their public Pins intact. Preserve the goat's tiny-object-in-serious-room mechanism as a directional attention signal, not evidence of traffic or conversion.
data.nextAction: Use functional product explanation and unique tracked canonical destinations in new creatives; never infer outbound effectiveness from the goat's two internal Pin clicks.
